setup_dexmachina_env: setup a DexMachina Genesis-based environment with config and reference data for robot hand simulation
compute_reward_dexmachina: compute the non-terminal step reward for Genesis batched worlds using object tracking and imitation
detect_terminated_samples: detect terminated samples using object position and rotation tracking error thresholds
step_simulation_env: step all simulation worlds forward with provided control inputs of shape N by nu
compute_contact_reward: compute the contact reward between robot hands and the object using Chamfer distance
